description: We are the White Holes, a new duo group who wants to solve a NASA Space Apps Challenge. We built MARSBOUND, an interactive 2D game which teaches kids 7-12 about how a Mars mission may go like. We added 5 missions for players to survive through, while learning the importance in each mission. In the game, they have to keep track of 3 resources; Oxygen, Water, and Energy. We included multiple NASA and Space Partner sources, like REM and RAD readings. In the end, we want kids to engage in learning.
